text: Fiona flies to Lisbon on 14 May at 6am. She's never done a flight on her own before and sounded quite anxious about it. Remind me to text her the night before.
Graham is properly obsessed with Hearts this season. He's got a season ticket now and goes with his son every other Saturday.
Coffee with Amara on Thursday at 10am was moved to Friday at half 10, same place.
Call with Sam earlier. He and his wife Kasia are off to Japan for three weeks from the 3rd of June. Must ask him for photos when they're back.
Olivia has taken up crochet and is making blankets for everyone. She said the next one is mine, which is sweet.
Jen's trip to Iceland is off. Her boss cancelled her leave at the last minute and she's fuming.
Need to post Oisín's birthday card by Wednesday morning. His birthday is 22/05 and he'll be in Galway.
Yasmin mentioned she wants the new Sally Rooney hardback. Worth remembering for Christmas.

Juan's long-haul flight to Santiago leaves Saturday at 11pm, nearly fifteen hours with a change in Madrid. His mum is having heart surgery out there next Thursday, so he's going to stay for a month to help his dad. He's trying to work remotely but the time difference will be awful. He sounded exhausted and quite low about the whole thing.
Pick up the dry cleaning tomorrow morning before 9.

Marcus plays bass in a covers band called The Late Shift, mostly nineties Britpop with the odd Motown number thrown in. They've got a gig at the Crown on Friday at 8pm and he's nervous because it's their first one with a new drummer, who only joined three weeks ago. He's been rehearsing every evening this week. I should go along and support him, and maybe bring Uma.
Uma said her dad retires on 30 June after thirty-one years at the council. The family are throwing him a party the following weekend.
Femi is heading to Lagos for his cousin's wedding on 9th August. Remind me to ask Femi how it went when he's home.
Leon is a big chess player, plays online most evenings and has a club night on Tuesdays. Rated about 1800 apparently.
Spoke to Dev and Eli at the barbecue. They're expecting their first baby in November and are moving to a bigger flat in Leeds before then.
Ciara's dog Biscuit has to have an operation on his knee on Monday at 2pm. She's worried sick about the cost and the anaesthetic. Text her on Monday evening to see how he's doing.
Emily got back from Peru last night. The Inca Trail was apparently brutal but worth it. I'm seeing her on Sunday for lunch to hear all about it.
Gemma is learning Welsh on Duolingo and has a streak of over 400 days. She wants to be able to talk to her nan in it.
Don't forget to send Manon the link to that pottery class in Bristol.
Mila's band are playing Glastonbury on the Friday this year. Small stage, but still! Her brother Ethan is driving the van down.
Jaya has a job interview at the British Museum on the 12th at half 9. She's been prepping for weeks. Should message her good luck the night before.

Dorota is flying home to Kraków on 18 December and staying until the 6th of January. She's taking her partner Fern to meet the family for the first time, and Fern is quite nervous about it, especially about Christmas Eve dinner with her grandmother, who speaks no English. Dorota has been teaching her a few Polish phrases in the evenings. I said I'd water their plants while they're away.
Yetunde is crazy about Formula 1. She's a Ferrari fan, despite everything, and she's going to Silverstone in July.
Vanessa called. Her mum's hip operation went well on Tuesday and she's home already. Need to drop some flowers round this weekend.
Booked my own flight to Toronto for 2 October at 7.40am. Window seat, finally.

Siobhan and her husband are celebrating their 25th anniversary with a cruise round the Norwegian fjords in September. They leave from Southampton on the 12th at 4pm and are away for ten nights. It's the first proper holiday they've had since the kids were small. She keeps hinting that they'd love a nice big photo frame for the pictures. Must get a card and a frame before they go.
Grace has been struggling since the breakup. She says she's fine, but she isn't sleeping. I'll call her tomorrow evening, around 7.
Saskia is running the Berlin Marathon on 27 September. Her training plan is relentless, five runs a week. Ask her for her finish time afterwards.
Fiona's daughter starts university in Edinburgh in September. Fiona is driving her up on the 14th with the whole car packed.
Graham Novak from the climbing wall mentioned he's off to the Dolomites for a fortnight in August. He climbs mostly trad and is keen on the via ferratas out there.
Amara collects vinyl, mostly seventies soul and Afrobeat. She's looking for an original pressing of Fela Kuti's Zombie, which would make the perfect present.
Lunch with Sam today was lovely. He's been made head of department and starts the new role after Easter. Must send him a card to say congratulations.
Kasia's Spanish exam is on 3 June at 9am. She's dreading the oral part. Wish her luck the day before.
Remember to bring the board games to Olivia's on Saturday at 4.

Long chat with Jen on the phone tonight. She's thinking of leaving her job at the bank and spending six months travelling around South East Asia, starting in Bangkok in January. Her parents aren't thrilled. She asked if I'd look after her cat Pepper while she's away, and I said probably yes. Her flat lease ends on 31/12, so she has to decide by November whether to renew. I should check in with her next week to see where she's landed.
Oisín plays hurling for his local club and has a county semi-final on Sunday afternoon.
Yasmin and her girlfriend have tickets for Taylor Swift in Dublin on 28 June. They're getting the ferry over the night before.
Juan is back from Chile. His mum is recovering slowly but it's been hard on him. Remind me to take Juan out for a pint next week.
Need to renew my passport before the trip in March.
Marcus said the gig was cancelled because the drummer broke his wrist. He's gutted. They're trying to rebook for next month.
Uma's sister Jaya is getting married in Goa on the 2nd of February. Uma is a bridesmaid and flies out the week before.
Femi supports Arsenal and gets very upset after a loss. Avoid football talk on Mondays.
Leon has his driving test on Friday at 11.15. Third attempt. He's really nervous this time.

Dev is a keen birdwatcher and is going to Shetland in May to see the puffins at Sumburgh Head. He's been on about it for years and has a whole spreadsheet of species he wants to tick off, including a snowy owl if he's very lucky. He takes the overnight ferry from Aberdeen on 10 May at 5pm. He asked to borrow my good binoculars, so I need to post them to him by the end of April.
Eli has started making sourdough and is very serious about it, with a starter named Doughvid.
Text Ciara on the 14th to see how Biscuit's stitches are healing.

Emily's brother Oisín is emigrating to New Zealand in the spring. He's got a job lined up at a hospital in Wellington and flies out on 2 April. Emily is quite upset about it but trying to be positive, and says their mum has been crying every time it comes up. Their whole family is having a farewell dinner on 15 March at 7pm. I should get him a little leaving present, maybe a good travel pillow for the flight.

Gemma and her partner have split up, so the trip to Greece they had planned for June is off. She lost the deposit on the hotel too, which made it worse. She's thinking of going on her own instead, maybe to Crete for a week, and doing some hiking in the Samaria Gorge. She seems a bit lost but more upbeat than last time. I should send her the details of that villa we stayed in near Chania.
Sort out travel insurance and order some euros before Thursday morning.
Mila's grandad died last week. The funeral is on Wednesday at 11am in Cork. Must send a card to her and her mum.
Ethan has just got into the county youth orchestra on viola. Huge deal for a fourteen-year-old. Congratulate him when I see him on Saturday.
Jaya got the job at the museum! She starts on 1 September as an assistant curator.
Dorota knits, mostly socks, and says she's finally ready to try a jumper. She'd love some good merino yarn.
Fern and Dorota's flight to Kraków was moved to 19 December at 6.15am. Fern is not a morning person, so that will be interesting.
Yetunde's brother Femi is doing a skydive for charity on 8th July. Remind me to sponsor him before then.

Vanessa asked if I could FaceTime her on Sunday at 6pm her time. She's in Vancouver for work until the end of the month and is getting homesick. She's been spending her weekends hiking and went whale watching last Saturday, which she loved. Her husband Marcus and the kids are flying out to join her for the last week, from the 24th.
Siobhan's son Sam finishes primary school next month and starts at St Patrick's in September. Big change.
Grace has booked a solo trip to Morocco from 4 to 11 April. First holiday since the breakup. Ask her afterwards how she found it.
Spoke to Saskia's husband Leon. Saskia hurt her calf in training and may have to pull out of the marathon. She's devastated. I should give her a ring this week, maybe Thursday evening.
Watched the match round at Graham's. He's still convinced Hearts will finish in the top four.
